questions.stem: In which Steganography Encryption Technique, we use Lime Water to hide data:
questions.explanation: Invisible ink (e.g., lime water) is a classical steganography technique.

questions.stem: _____________ is another data hiding technique which can be used in conjunction with cryptography for the extra-secure method of protecting data.
questions.explanation: Steganography hides existence of data and can complement cryptography.
